messages:
avik: Morning standup — quick async check (what I did / blockers / today)

avik: Did: landed kernel latencies patch for async batching (reduced tail p99 by ~8%). Instrumented slot-stealing metrics and added end-to-end timers.

avik: Blockers: flaky KV cache eviction on long-running canaries; saw one microburst OOM on shard-7. Need deeper trace to know if allocator or eviction logic. :grimacing:

avik: Today: triage eviction traces, add a conservative guard in allocator, and run a cross-shard microburst perf sweep.

maria: Nice — for traces please emit per-shard key-count and eviction-reason. I can map that into the metrics pipeline and look for correlation with traffic patterns.

avik: Good call. Adding per-shard key-count now. Pushing a tiny PR shortly. cc @cheng for allocator tweaks.

cheng: On it. I'll prototype a cap-first fallback in the allocator and run a local perf pass. If you want a repro, run this locally:
```
./bench_runner --model=redwood-kernel-v2 --seq-len=512 --batch=12 --duration=60
```
I'll try cap values [0.6,0.75,0.9] and report p50/p95/p99.

maria: I queued a kv-cache canary with a longer eviction window (30s -> 60s) to reduce churn noise; will watch for p99 changes. :eyes:

dev-bot: deploy-success: canary/kv-evict-window updated by maria at 2026-03-20T08:12Z :white_check_mark:

avik: After cheng's tweak, let's run the microburst bench across 3 shards and compare the histograms. Post results here and tag me.

cheng: Quick Q — should the allocator change be behind a feature flag for a safer rollout?

avik: Yes. Feature flag: runtime.alloc.cap_fallback (default: false). We'll enable on staging for 1h then promote if stable.

maria: Also adding a small prompt set to the Redwood-opt-bench suite to ensure generation quality doesn't regress with the batching changes.

avik: Sounds good. If the tracer logs show eviction spikes tied to specific keys, we should consider sharding-hot-key mitigation (small LRU preferential retention).

cheng: I'll include a debug switch to sample hot keys (10% sampling) when flag is on.

avik: Perfect. No other blockers from me — will post bench graphs once the allocator canary runs. :rocket:

maria: Thanks team. I'll monitor canary dashboards and slack-alerts. Ping if you want me to rollback the window change.

dev-bot: perf-report-placeholder: microburst job queued (id: mb-20260320-01)

avik: Closing loop: follow-ups are PRs for per-shard metrics, allocator feature-flagged patch, and updated opt-bench prompt set.
